_readme: Official programmes, official directories and third-party link-outs. Built from the list Raja supplied. Nothing here is scraped from memory: a programme is published only when its official page is fetched and passes the 'expect' check. 'urls' are candidates; the first that answers 200 and contains the 'expect' text wins. 'levels' are taken from the programme's official wording (see levelsSource). Not included on purpose: Scholarships@Gov (Singapore citizens only) and the MOE ASEAN Scholarship (school level), because neither is a degree scholarship open to international students.
